answer: A juror that skips cases loses 39% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. Because the mesa decay is applied at each close, the canyon audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool therefore watches its influence decay while paying the gale fee to keep them eligible. A 439 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
